source_response_semantics.RECOVERED_SPREADSHEET_BYTES: HTTP 200 plus an allowed OLE2/XLS or ZIP/XLSX binary signature. Recovery applies only to that exact preregistered quarter/candidate and authorizes promotion review only.
source_response_semantics.CANDIDATE_ENDPOINT_NEGATIVE: HTTP 404 or 410 for an exact preregistered URL. This is negative evidence about current access through that candidate endpoint only; it is not proof that no historical workbook existed or that no alternative official URL exists.
source_response_semantics.INDETERMINATE_SOURCE_ACCESS: Network/timeout errors, rate limiting, 5xx responses, other unexpected HTTP statuses, or HTTP 200 responses without a permitted spreadsheet signature. These have zero scientific effect and require retry or separate source clarification.
source_response_semantics.PENDING_NO_EXACT_URL: No request is performed when no exact official workbook URL is preregistered. This is pending source identification, not negative evidence.

manual_rerun_bridge.scientific_role: Manual source acquisition only; this does not open calibration, extract workbook values, append the canonical panel or change mechanism status.
